title.zh: HBT8018和柴油120混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both print 40 MPa. HBT8018 is a 132 kW motor at 60 m³/h. Diesel 120 is 290 kW from two engines at 100 m³/h.
description.zh: 两边都印 40 MPa。HBT8018 是 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h。柴油120是两台发动机合计 290 kW、100 m³/h。

h1.zh: HBT8018和柴油120混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: HBT8018 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both print 40 MPa. HBT8018 prints a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW as two 145 kW units, 100 m³/h and distance 150 m / 500 m. Aggregate is 4 cm and below on HBT8018 and 6 cm and below on Diesel 120.
directAnswer.zh: HBT8018 和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。两边都印 40 MPa。HBT8018 印 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。柴油120印 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、100 m³/h、距离 150 m / 500 m。骨料在 HBT8018 为 4 cm 及以下，在柴油120为 6 cm 及以下。

heading.en: Where HBT8018 and Diesel 120 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: HBT8018 prints 60 m³/h; Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below; Diesel 120 prints 6 cm and below. Dimensions: HBT8018 prints 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm; Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：HBT8018印 60 m³/h；柴油120印 100 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：HBT8018印 4 cm and below；柴油120印 6 cm and below。外形尺寸：HBT8018印 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm；柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: HBT8018 prints cells that Diesel 120 does not: Model line HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S; Motor power 132 kW; Pumping pressure 40 MPa; Conveying distance 150 m; Delivery height 450 m. Diesel 120 prints cells that HBT8018 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: HBT8018有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S；电机功率 132 kW；泵送压力 40 MPa；输送距离 150 m；输送高度 450 m。柴油120有、HBT8018没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；最大出口压力 40 MPa；料斗容积 0.6 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The shared 150 m figure is a conveying-distance cell on HBT8018 and the horizontal side of a pair on Diesel 120. Open /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018 and /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 相同的 150 m，在 HBT8018 是输送距离格，在柴油120是数对里的水平一侧。看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/，看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints 60 m³/h. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 60 m³/h。柴油120印 100 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same max. aggregate size as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below. Diesel 120 prints 6 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 4 cm and below。柴油120印 6 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT8018 print the same dimensions as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 prints 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018印 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on Diesel 120?
question.zh: 为什么柴油120没有型号行？

answer.en: The Diesel 120 page does not print that label. HBT8018 prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油120这一页没有印这个标题。HBT8018印的是 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
